statements.t: The market value of the Company’s SKY holdings will continue to fluctuate, potentially significantly, with the market price of SKY and the number of tokens held, and the price of SKY as of any future date may be substantially lower.

The Company intends to announce material information to the public through filings with the SEC, the investor relations page of its website (www.stabledev.com), press releases, public conference calls, public webcasts, its X (Twitter) account (@StableDev), and its LinkedIn page.

risks.t: the concentration of the Company’s assets in a single digital asset
the impact of non-cash fair value adjustments on reported results
the liquidity of SKY tokens and potential market impact of large transactions
dilution from the exercise of outstanding pre-funded warrants and sales under the ATM Program
limitations on the Company’s ability to access the capital markets and to maintain its NYSE American listing
the unremediated material weakness in the Company’s internal control over financial reporting
